integrity: A direct all-integer block proof distinguishes occurrences from distinct factors. A standalone Python test independently generates symbols and checks finite cases; computational checks are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for length \(q^k\) and \(2q^k\) factors, not arbitrary lengths. Total factor complexity and the ordinary Cantor maximum one-count were known separately. Independent literature review may find an equivalent extremal-fiber classification.
title: Extremal-weight factor classes at substitution scales in Cantor-like words
